spans.s: प्रगंड m. The upper part of the arm from the elbow to the shoulder.
प्रगंडी f. The outer wall of a city.
प्रगत a. (f. ता) 1. Gone forward; 2. separate, apart.
प्रगत a. (f. ता) 1. Gone forward; 2. separate, apart.
प्रगत-जानु, -जानुक a. bandy-legged, bow-legged.
प्रगत-जानु, -जानुक a. bandy-legged, bow-legged.
प्रगम m. The first advance in love-making.
प्रगमन n. 1. Advance, progress; 2. the first advance in love-making.
प्रगर्जन n. Roaring.

प्रगल्भ a. (f. ल्भा) 1. Bold, daring; 2. eloquent, पुंवत्प्रगल्भा R.vi.20; 3. spirited, courageous, R.ii.41; 4. audacious, arrogant, officious, R.xiii.9; 5. shameless; 6. strong; 7. mature, K.S.v.30; 8. illustrious, eminent; 9. developed, great.

प्रगल्भ a. (f. ल्भा) 1. Bold, daring; 2. eloquent, पुंवत्प्रगल्भा R.vi.20; 3. spirited, courageous, R.ii.41; 4. audacious, arrogant, officious, R.xiii.9; 5. shameless; 6. strong; 7. mature, K.S.v.30; 8. illustrious, eminent; 9. developed, great.
प्रगल्भा f. 1. A bold woman; 2. a scolding woman, a shrew; 3. a bold woman experienced in love-matters considered as a character in poetic composition. See मध्यमा and मुग्धा.
प्रगाढ (I) a. (f. ढा) 1. Much, excessive; 2. hard, difficult; 3. firm.
प्रगाढ (II) n. Privation.(प्रगाढम् is used as an indeclinable in the sense of- (1) exceedingly; (2) firmly.)
प्रगाढ (I) a. (f. ढा) 1. Much, excessive; 2. hard, difficult; 3. firm.
प्रगातृ m. An excellent singer.
प्रगुण a. (f. णा) 1. Having an excellent quality, being in the right state, श्रमजयात्प्रगुणां च करोत्यसौ तनुमतोऽनुमतः सचिवैर्ययौ R.ix.49; 2. honest, upright; 3. clever, skilful.
प्रगुण a. (f. णा) 1. Having an excellent quality, being in the right state, श्रमजयात्प्रगुणां च करोत्यसौ तनुमतोऽनुमतः सचिवैर्ययौ R.ix.49; 2. honest, upright; 3. clever, skilful.
प्रगुणित a. (f. ता) 1. Made straight; 2. made smooth.
प्रगुणित a. (f. ता) 1. Made straight; 2. made smooth.
प्रगृहीत a. (f. ता) 1. Received, accepted; 2. pronounced separately without observing the rules of sandhi.
प्रगृहीत a. (f. ता) 1. Received, accepted; 2. pronounced separately without observing the rules of sandhi.
प्रगृह्य m. A word allowed to be written or pronounced separately without observing the usual rules of sandhi.
प्रगे ind. Early in the morning, at daybreak, इत्थं रथाश्वेभनिषादिनां प्रगे गणो नृपाणामथ तोरणाद्बहिः Sis.xii.1, M.iv.62, vi.6.
प्रगे-तन a. to be performed in the morning.
प्रगे-निश a. who is asleep at daybreak.
प्रगोपन n. Protection, preservation.
प्रग्रथन n. Stringing together.

प्रग्रह m. 1. Grasping, clutching, seizing; 2. the commencement of an eclipse; 3. a rein, a bridle; 4. restraint, confinement; 5. the string of a balance; 6. the arm; 7. a ray of light; 8. a prisoner, a captive; 9. a vowel not subject to the rules of sandhi.
प्रग्राह m. 1. the string of a balance; 2. a rein, a bridle.
प्रग्रहण n. 1. Taking, seizing; 2. the commencement of an eclipse; 3. a rein, a bridle.
प्रग्रीव m.n. 1. A wooden fence round a building; 2. a window; 3. a stable; 4. top of a tree.

प्रागल्भ्य n. 1. Confidence, boldness, जाता शिखंडिनी प्राग् यथा शिखंडी तथैव गच्छामि । प्रागल्भ्यामधिकमाप्तुं वाणी बाणो बभूवेति Govardhana; 2. pride, arrogance; 3. proficiency, skill; 4. pomp, rank; 5. development, greatness; 6. eloquence, प्रागल्भ्यमभ्यस्तगुणा च वाणी M.M.iii.
प्रागार m. A house, a building.
प्राग्र n. The highest point.
प्राग्र-अट n. thin coagulated milk.
प्राग्र-सर a. foremost, first.
प्राग्र-हर a. chief, principal.
प्राग्र्य a. (f. ग्र्या) Best, chief, most excellent.
प्राग्र्य a. (f. ग्र्या) Best, chief, most excellent.
प्रागग्र a. having the point turned towards the east.
प्रागभाव m. previous nonexistence of a thing that has come into being, nonexistence of a thing previous to its production.
प्रागभिहित a. mentioned before.
प्रागवस्था f. a former state, न तर्हि प्रागवथायाः परिहीयसे ‘you are not then worse off,’ M.M.iv.
प्रागायत a. extending towards the east.
प्रागुक्ति f. previous utterance.
प्रागुत्तर a. north-eastern.
प्रागुदीची f. the north-east.
प्राच्-जन्मन् n. a former birth.
प्राच्-जाति f. a former birth.
प्राच्-ज्योतिष (I) m. name of a country otherwise called Kāmarūpa.
प्राच्-ज्योतिष (II) m.f. the people of this country.
प्राच्-ज्योतिष (III) n. name of a city.
प्राच्-ज्योतिष˚ज्येष्ठ m. an epithet of Viṣṇu.
प्राच्-दक्षिण a. south-eastern.
प्राच्-देश n. the eastern country.
प्राच्-द्वार, -द्वारिक a. having doors on the eastern side.
प्राच्-द्वार, -द्वारिक a. having doors on the eastern side.
प्राच्-भक्त n. taking medicine before diet.
प्राच्-भाग m. the front, the forepart.
प्राच्-भार m. 1. the peak of a mountain; 2. a heap, a multitude; 3. the forepart or end of anything, फेरवचंडडाकृतिभृतप्राग्भारभीमैस्तटैः M.M.v.
प्राच्-भाव m. 1. previous existence; 2. excellence, superiority.

प्राच्-वंश m. 1. a sacrificial chamber having columns towards the east, R.xvi.61 and Mall. on it); according to some, however, the word means ‘a room where the friends of the sacrificer assemble’; 2. a former dynasty.
प्राच्-वत् ind. as before, as previously.
प्राच्-वृत्तांत m. a former event.
